ammonia.reason: Short 3-week ripening with Geotrichum/P.candidum gives limited amino acid deamination to NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Goat milk p-cresol, indole and phenols from pasture plus caprine lipolysis give barnyard note.

bitter.reason: Low-level hydrophobic peptides from chymosin and starter peptidases in lactic curd.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation so no blue methyl-ketone 2-heptanone/2-nonanone pathway.

browning.reason: Moderate protein and residual lactate/sugars allow Maillard on chèvre-chaud grilling.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis citrate metabolism yields diacetyl/acetoin.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Lipoprotein lipase plus Geotrichum lipases release C4-C8 free fatty acids butanoic/hexanoic.

creaminess.reason: Surface flora proteolysis and pH rise liquefy paste under bloomy ash rind to creamy layer.

crumbliness.reason: Low-pH demineralized acid gel lacks calcium crosslinks and fractures into chalky crumbs.

firmness.reason: Lactic acid gel with drained 55-57% moisture retains firm chalky core when ripe.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol by starter and yeasts.

fruity.reason: Microbial esterases form low ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from free fatty acids and ethanol.

goaty.reason: Goat-specific branched-chain 4-methyloctanoic and 4-ethyloctanoic acids released by lipolysis.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker degradation of leucine/isoleucine to 3-methylbutanal gives light nutty note.

melt.reason: Acid-demineralized low-pH curd softens and creams but shows limited viscous flow on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Geotrichum candidum and P.candidum produce 1-octen-3-ol and earthy metabolites on ash rind.

oil_off.reason: Moderate fat bound in acid protein matrix releases little free oil on warming.

smoky.reason: Vegetable charcoal ash is color coating only with no wood-smoke guaiacol deposition.

sour_vinegar.reason: Predominant L-lactic acid plus trace acetic from heterofermentative flora at pH ~4.5.

stretch.reason: No hot-water kneading and acid curd has no intact calcium-paracasein stretch network.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Uncooked lactic make with no high heat gives minimal methionine to methanethiol/DMS.

sweet.reason: Most lactose fermented to lactate leaving slight sweet from milk fat lactones and proteins.

umami.reason: Short proteolysis by rennet and surface flora releases modest glutamate peptides.
